data.one_liner: Official UI package and SDK for Stream Video, supporting calls and livestreams.
data.what_it_does: Provides UI components, state handling, and WebRTC integration for building video calls, audio rooms, and live-streaming applications powered by Stream.
use_when: You are building video calls, audio rooms, or livestreams using the Stream backend service.
You need pre-built UI components and state management specifically for Stream Video SDK.
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Stream for your video infrastructure.
You need fully supported web or desktop native video calls (official support is limited to Android and iOS).
strengths: Official UI and state management package for Stream Video SDK
Rich set of features including screen sharing, active speaker, push notifications, and call recording
Dynascale support for automatic resolution and codec switching
weaknesses: Official support is limited to Android and iOS; web and macOS have limited support
Requires using Stream's backend infrastructure and services
data.setup_notes: Requires registering on Stream to get an API key, configuring permissions, and setting up native platform integrations for Android and iOS.
